top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a mature, complete discovery chain: proglucagon processing, identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide and its glucose-dependent insulinotropic and satiety actions were established as physiology before any drug existed, and have since been confirmed by replicated trials in type 2 diabetes and obesity. The allocation to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov with a physiology-and-peptide-identity citation is defensible and keeps the scope on discovery rather than a company drug programme; no award would withhold a clearly ripe, high-impact achievement.
